profile.name: Pritam
profile.tagline: Embedded Systems Engineer | Crafting AI-Powered Hardware
profile.shortBio: I build the hardware that thinks. My work lives at the intersection of embedded engineering and machine learning, where I design PCBs, write firmware, and deploy algorithms to create intelligent, real-world systems from the ground up.

about.fullBio: My fascination is with bringing code to life in the physical world. I'm an embedded engineer who thrives on the entire product lifecycle, from designing the silicon-level architecture to deploying the machine learning models that give it intelligence. I'm hands-on across the full stack, whether that's deep in a C++ datasheet, prototyping a new PCB, or optimizing a Python algorithm. My goal is always the same: to build tangible, efficient, and forward-thinking solutions to real-world problems. When I'm not in the lab, I'm constantly exploring the bleeding edge of automation and the future of IoT.

experience.title: Embedded Application Engineer
description: Developing and debugging firmware for various microcontrollers using Embedded C for production-ready PCBs.
Designing and prototyping embedded solutions with CuPID development boards for scalable real-world applications.
Integrating hardware and software to create robust systems for IoT and automation.
Collaborating on PCB design and layout, ensuring functionality and performance optimization.
